summary: Comprehensive testing of GymAxis CRM v2 new features: Role-Based Dashboard (4 variants), 2FA/TOTP Authentication, Cross-Module Navigation, and existing features regression. All 17 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified all major features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test entities created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (Role-Based Dashboard, 2FA/TOTP, Cross-Module Navigation) are working correctly. Backend tests cover: CRM Auth (login success/failure), 2FA Flow (status, setup, verify, full flow with enable/disable), Role-Based Dashboard (role, stagnating_deals, cases_by_severity, my_tasks, upcoming_meetings, director metrics), Global Search (results with type/id, multiple entity types), Cross-Module Navigation (company/contact/opportunity detail endpoints), KPI Navigation (all KPI data present). Frontend tests verified: Dashboard with 4 role variants (Sales Manager, Service Admin, Engineer, Director), Role switcher buttons, KPI cards, Global search, Quick Create menu, Notifications panel, Settings with Security tab and 2FA UI, All 10 sidebar navigation items, Workflows page with CRUD, Pipeline kanban view, Companies list, Activity Feed/Inbox.

role_based_dashboard.details: All 4 role variants working: Sales Manager (pipeline-focused), Service Admin (cases-focused), Engineer (my-tasks-focused), Director (revenue/conversion-focused). Role switcher visible for manager role. Dashboard returns role, stagnating_deals, cases_by_severity, my_tasks, upcoming_meetings, win_rate, won_count, lost_count.

2fa_totp_authentication.details: Full 2FA flow tested: GET /api/crm/auth/2fa/status returns enabled/has_backup_codes, POST /api/crm/auth/2fa/setup returns secret/qr_code/provisioning_uri/backup_codes(8), POST /api/crm/auth/2fa/verify-setup enables 2FA, Login returns requires_2fa=true with temp_token, POST /api/crm/auth/2fa/validate with TOTP code returns full token, Backup code login works and decrements remaining count, POST /api/crm/auth/2fa/disable with password disables 2FA. Frontend Settings > Security tab shows 2FA status and Enable button.

cross_module_navigation.details: Global search returns results with type/id/label for navigation. Company/Contact/Opportunity detail endpoints return all linked data (contacts, opportunities, quotes, cases, assets, activities). KPI cards are clickable and navigate to correct modules.

existing_features_regression.details: All 10 sidebar navigation items work. Workflows page shows list with Active status and New Workflow button. Pipeline kanban view shows stages with deals. Companies list with filters. Activity Feed with type filters. Quick Create and Notifications working.
